messages:
Ravi: Quick pass — signed Aurora Health POC this morning. Private deployment (VPC) with SSO (SAML) + SCIM required. POC target: ~10 TPS, ~50k tokens/day. Procurement flagged renewal sensitivity if 95p latency >200ms. Immediate: during demo they hit a profile-sync 500. Assigning Anika as CS owner. @Marco can you triage the 500? I attached the demo logs and sample certs in the thread.
Anika: Got it — I'll take ownership for onboarding. I'll schedule a kickoff for Tue 10am PT and share the agenda. Lina, can you open a support ticket with the logs and initial repro steps? Marco, we'll need an SSO/SCIM mapping matrix before kickoff.
Marco: Will triage. Can you paste the 500 stack trace and the SCIM mapping they expect? Quick check — are they on the new SSO adapter or the legacy connector? If it's legacy we may need a small patch.
Lina: Created support ticket #12345 and attached the logs from today's demo. Repro steps included in the ticket. Noted SCIM attribute mismatch on profile sync. I'll monitor and escalate to eng if Marco requests more traces.
Ravi: Contract link: https://redwood.example/contracts/AUR-2026. Note: they prefer EU data residency long-term but are okay with us-east for the POC. Procurement also asked for SOC2 excerpts — I'll forward the compliance pack.
Anika: Onboarding checklist (short):
- Kickoff (Tue 10am PT)
- Provision private sandbox (VPC)
- Run SSO + SCIM tests
- Latency & cost baseline (capture 95p latency, tokens/day)
- Capture product feedback & enablement needs
Owners: Ravi (sales), Anika (CS), Marco (eng), Lina (support). I'll drop invite and the shared doc.
Marco: Preliminary triage: 500 originates in the SCIM sync where attribute `userPrincipalName` is null for certain records. Patch plan: defensive parsing + better null handling and extra logging. Opening ENG-8890 and will link to support#12345. ETA for patch: ~2 business days, then we'll validate in their sandbox.
Lina: Support will hold for the ENG patch before running full repro. I've added the Aurora technical contacts to the ticket and CC'd procurement contacts for compliance artifacts.
Ravi: One more ask from the customer PO — they want per-route token cost breakdown in the console and clearer per-model latency SLO reporting. Please capture as product feedback in onboarding doc.
Anika: Will add product asks to the onboarding doc and schedule a product sync in week 2 post-kickoff. Next steps summarized in the doc and ticket links. Thanks all — closing loop here unless anyone needs to add items. :white_check_mark:
